Table Theme: Analysis of Investment Performance by Vintage Year

Columns.Vintage: This column represents the year in which the investment fund was established or the capital was first committed. It is crucial for understanding the time frame of the investment and comparing performance across different years.
Columns.Preqin Median Net IRR: This column shows the median net Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for investments of a particular vintage year, as reported by Preqin. It provides a measure of the average annual return on investments, net of fees, and is used to assess the performance of funds relative to their peers.
Columns.LN PME Using S&P 500 TR: This column represents the Logarithmic Public Market Equivalent (PME) calculated using the S&P 500 Total Return index. It is a metric used to compare the performance of private equity investments against the public market, specifically the S&P 500, to determine if the private investments have outperformed or underperformed the public market.

Column Relationships.Vintage: The 'Vintage' column is used in conjunction with 'Preqin Median Net IRR' and 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' to analyze how investment performance varies by the year of inception. It helps in identifying trends and patterns over time.
Column Relationships.Preqin Median Net IRR: The 'Preqin Median Net IRR' column is compared with 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' to evaluate whether the median returns of private investments exceed those of the public market for each vintage year.
Column Relationships.LN PME Using S&P 500 TR: The 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' column is related to 'Preqin Median Net IRR' as it provides a benchmark for comparing private equity returns against the public market, allowing for a relative performance analysis for each vintage year.
